# Indexer

## Rules

- `IndexCodeGraph`: primary application write path. Pipeline: discover workspace plus global resources; diff hashes/spec fingerprints; extract code or text documents; index specs through `SpecRepository` + `GetSpecMetadata`; store nodes/relations; remove deleted resources; persist `lastIndexedRef`. Include `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Consume `SpecRepository.list`, `artifact`, `readPersistedImplementation` and `GetSpecMetadata`; never parse raw sidecars or raw metadata snapshots when self-healing projection exists.
- Incremental run compares discovered file `contentHash` and persisted graph fingerprint. Current fingerprint combines running `@specd/code-graph` version plus canonical hash of resolved workspace objects. If fingerprint matches: process new/changed/deleted only; unchanged files skip parsing/I/O beyond hash comparison. Delete only files belonging to indexed workspaces. Remove changed files before CSV `COPY FROM` bulk load.
- Fingerprint mismatch triggers active-store full rebuild, preferably `recreate()` plus visible version/config reason; backend MAY fail fast requiring explicit force reindex. Force full reindex invokes graph-store recreation before `execute()`.
- Effective discovery fingerprint MUST include project `graph.includePaths`, global `graph.excludePaths`, each workspace `allowedPaths`, `excludePaths`, `respectGitignore`, and synthetic filesystem-backed `specsPath` exclusions.
- Workspace discovery: for each `ProjectWorkspace`, combine global exclusions, repository spec-root exclusions, workspace exclusions; call `discoverFiles(codeRoot, allowedPaths?)`; prefix `{workspaceName}:`; diff by workspace prefix.
- Project-global discovery: call `discoverFiles(projectRoot)` with `graphConfig.includePaths`; prefix `root:`; accept only resources outside every workspace `codeRoot`. Adapter-backed resources become `FileNode`; other textual resources become `DocumentNode`. Filesystem-backed repository `specsPath` is synthetically excluded; specs index only through spec phase.
- Text fallback: accept BOM `utf-8`, `utf-16le`, `utf-16be`; else try `utf-8`; else matching UTF-16 null-byte layout; else `windows-1252` only without NUL; otherwise skip non-text.
- `discoverFiles` options: `respectGitignore` default `true`, hierarchical `.gitignore` absolute priority; `excludePaths` default built-ins including `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`; `vcsRoot: string | null` bounds `.gitignore` search and MUST be explicit; discovery MUST NOT probe VCS markers.
- Filter known binary/non-source extensions before decoding, including `.gif`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.pdf`, `.sql`, `.zip`, `.tiff`, `.pack`.
- Memory: reuse session lookups; retain compact per-file analyses, never parser ASTs/trees across run. Pass 1 MAY allocate heavyweight parser state only transiently per file.
- Two-pass extraction via shared in-memory `IndexSession`:
  1. Pass 1 per workspace/chunk: read, derive complete adapter `FileAnalysis`, register analysis, emit `DEFINES`/`EXPORTS`; no store queries.
  2. Pass 2 after Pass 1 for all workspaces: resolve imports and scoped bindings from session facts; derive deterministic `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, hierarchy, other relations without reparse/store queries.
  3. Specs per workspace via `SpecRepository`.
  4. Commit once with `GraphStore.bulkLoad()`; then `GraphStore.rebuildFtsIndexes()`.
- `IndexSession` run scope: stable numeric file IDs; analyses by ID/workspace path; symbols by file/name/qualified name; documents/specs; file↔symbol/spec↔symbol indexes; parser facts; deduplicated relations. Common API required for adapters/phases; adapter compact cache allowed only through API. Session never alters persisted schemas, IDs, relation semantics.
- Pass 2 builds shared per-file scoped binding environment from adapter binding/call facts, symbols, imports/maps, namespace maps, session indexes. Deterministic lookup covers enclosing scope, shadowing, local/parameter/property/class-managed/inherited/file/global/framework/imported types; receivers `this`, `self`, `cls`, `parent`, `super` and equivalents; free/member/static/constructor candidates.
- Resolve `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `IMPORTS`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` only when deterministic. Drop symbol self-relations. Unresolved/ambiguous facts produce no persisted relation; non-persisted diagnostics MAY remain. Shared logic owns resolution; `IndexCodeGraph` contains no language-specific resolution.
- Chunk files by total source size, default `20 MB`; sequential chunks allow collection. Configure via `IndexOptions.chunkBytes`. Optional spill artifacts MUST use configured graph temp directory, current-run scope, cleanup after success, SHOULD cleanup after failure.
- `IndexOptions.onProgress?: (percent: number, phase: string) => void`: discovery/hash 0–5%; diff/cleanup 5–7%; Pass 1 7–50%; Pass 2 50–80%; specs 80–83%; bulk load 83–95%; done 100%. Per-item phases include detail such as `150/460 files`. Fire phase completion before next synchronous/heavy work.
- Log major phase durations at `debug`: discovery, Pass 1, Pass 2, spec indexing, bulk load.
- Cross-workspace packages: before Pass 2, build `packageName → workspaceName` by calling every adapter `getPackageIdentity(codeRoot)`; first defined wins. For non-relative import, extract package, map workspace, search session symbols by imported name within workspace. Language/manifest-agnostic; works mono/multirepo.
- Per-file extraction/storage errors: catch, record `{ filePath, message }`, continue. Only infrastructure failures such as lost store/disk-full abort.
- `IndexResult`: `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesRemoved`, `filesSkipped`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`, `errors`, `duration`, per-workspace `{ name, filesDiscovered, filesIndexed, filesSkipped, filesRemoved, specsDiscovered, specsIndexed }`, persisted `vcsRef | null`, persisted `graphFingerprint`, `fullRebuildReason | null`.
- Spec indexing: `repo.count()` for progress; `repo.list()` identities; `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })`; compare semantic `metadataFingerprint` with stored `SpecNode`; load materialized title/description; `repo.readPersistedImplementation()` for `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL`; `repo.readPersistedDependsOn()` for `DEPENDS_ON`. No CLI pre-extraction; indexer owns mapping. Prefer non-empty `optimizedDescription` over `description` for BM25/display.

## Constraints

- `GraphStore` already open; indexer never manages lifecycle.
- Normalize discovery paths to forward-slash workspace-relative form.
- Omitted `excludePaths`: built-ins `node_modules/`, `.git/`, `.specd/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `.next/`, `.nuxt/`; provided value replaces defaults, never merges. `.gitignore` has absolute priority when enabled.
- Pass 1 completes for ALL workspaces before Pass 2; never interleave per file/workspace.
- Per-file errors collected; only infrastructure errors thrown.
- Specs only through workspace `specs()` callback; no filesystem fallback.
- Scoped resolution uses in-memory pass facts only; no graph-store queries, language rules in `IndexCodeGraph`, unresolved relations, or self-relations.
